panels.title: CPU Usage: Actual (Solid) vs Predicted (Dash, +5m ahead)

targets.query: from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_usage") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.type == "actual") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> drop(columns: ["metric", "type", "handler"]) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "CPU Usage (actual)" }))

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_usage") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.type == "predicted" and r.horizon == "300s") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> drop(columns: ["metric", "type", "handler"]) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "CPU Usage (predicted)" }))

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_error") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value") |> drop(columns: ["metric", "type", "handler"]) |> last()

from(bucket: "${INFLUXDB_BUCKET}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_error") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> drop(columns: ["metric", "type", "handler"]) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Error" }))
